name: Possessed

bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 point of Ruin at the start of each of this Threat's turns.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Mark of Chaos
bonuses.text: This Threat has a Mark of Chaos (W&G p.136)

bonuses.name: Space Marine Implants
bonuses.text: Gain bonus dice and options for actions from Space Marine Implants (W&G p.75)

abilities.name: Turn the Galaxy Red With Blood!
abilities.text: Anyone who encounters this Threat must make a DN 3 Fear Test.

abilities.name: Wanton Slaughter
abilities.text: When a Possessed successfully hits with a Wrath Critical in melee they deal +2 Mortal Wounds.

abilities.name: Veteran of the Long War
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to add the game's Tier as ED to all attacks this Threat makes this Round

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 8d6. Possessed can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
note: Different name from Core's Possessed Chaos Space Marine (possessed-chaos-space-marine) and Possessed Mortal; closest is possessed-chaos-space-marine. Trait 'Rend (1)' printed (Core catalogue says Rending).
